notes.title: Small Update + Tournament Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Kongers! 

First off, thanks so much to all of you who have downloaded the game so far! Today's update brings you a way to keep playing the game after you run out of coins.  You now get 1 free coin a day when you log in to the game.  Right now the system waits for 24h to pass, but i'll fix that so it just resets by day.

Also, we've fixed high score logging, so get in there and beat my score!

And finally, we will be at PAX East this year, and running a tournament.  Winners of the tournament get a free CK Arcade cabinet!
